__inputs.name: DS_PROMETHEUS
__inputs.label: Prometheus
__inputs.description: A Prometheus data source scraping this server's /metrics, or ingesting its OTLP metrics push (see docs/observability.md for the promote_resource_attributes + collector requirements on the OTLP path).

targets.expr: sum by (outcome) (rate(mcp_tool_invocation_total{broker=~"$broker"}[5m]) * on (instance, job) group_left(cloud_region) target_info{job=~"$service_name", cloud_region=~"$cloud_region"})
sum(rate(mcp_tool_invocation_total{outcome="error", broker=~"$broker"}[5m]) * on (instance, job) group_left(cloud_region) target_info{job=~"$service_name", cloud_region=~"$cloud_region"})

panels.title: Tool call latency (p50/p95/p99)
panels.description: Exemplars (clickable trace links) need: tracing enabled on the server, a Prometheus started with --enable-feature=exemplar-storage, OpenMetrics negotiation on the scrape, and this datasource's Exemplars config pointing at a Tempo/Jaeger data source. Renders as a plain latency panel with none of that configured.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (le) (rate(mcp_tool_invocation_duration_seconds_bucket{broker=~"$broker"}[5m]) * on (instance, job) group_left(cloud_region) target_info{job=~"$service_name", cloud_region=~"$cloud_region"}))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(mcp_tool_invocation_duration_seconds_bucket{broker=~"$broker"}[5m]) * on (instance, job) group_left(cloud_region) target_info{job=~"$service_name", cloud_region=~"$cloud_region"}))

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(mcp_tool_invocation_duration_seconds_bucket{broker=~"$broker"}[5m]) * on (instance, job) group_left(cloud_region) target_info{job=~"$service_name", cloud_region=~"$cloud_region"}))
mcp_http_active_requests * on (instance, job) group_left(cloud_region) target_info{job=~"$service_name", cloud_region=~"$cloud_region"}
sum by (operation) (rate(mcp_semp_request_total{broker=~"$broker"}[5m]) * on (instance, job) group_left(cloud_region) target_info{job=~"$service_name", cloud_region=~"$cloud_region"})

panels.title: SEMP error rate by status code

targets.expr: sum by (http_response_status_code) (rate(mcp_semp_request_total{broker=~"$broker", http_response_status_code!~"2.."}[5m]) * on (instance, job) group_left(cloud_region) target_info{job=~"$service_name", cloud_region=~"$cloud_region"})

panels.title: SEMP request latency (p50/p95/p99)
panels.description: Same exemplar prerequisites as the tool-call latency panel above.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (le) (rate(mcp_semp_request_duration_seconds_bucket{broker=~"$broker"}[5m]) * on (instance, job) group_left(cloud_region) target_info{job=~"$service_name", cloud_region=~"$cloud_region"}))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(mcp_semp_request_duration_seconds_bucket{broker=~"$broker"}[5m]) * on (instance, job) group_left(cloud_region) target_info{job=~"$service_name", cloud_region=~"$cloud_region"}))

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(mcp_semp_request_duration_seconds_bucket{broker=~"$broker"}[5m]) * on (instance, job) group_left(cloud_region) target_info{job=~"$service_name", cloud_region=~"$cloud_region"}))

panels.title: Auth failure rate by reason
panels.description: signature_invalid (Decision #7) distinguishes JWKS-rotation/stale-cache failures from malformed-token failures.

targets.expr: sum by (reason) (rate(mcp_auth_failure_total[5m]) * on (instance, job) group_left(cloud_region) target_info{job=~"$service_name", cloud_region=~"$cloud_region"})

panels.title: Tool errors by error_type (ADR-009)
panels.description: sum by (error_type) (rate(mcp_tool_invocation_total{outcome="error"}[5m])) — answers "show me all crashes" via error_type="panic".

targets.expr: sum by (error_type) (rate(mcp_tool_invocation_total{outcome="error", broker=~"$broker"}[5m]) * on (instance, job) group_left(cloud_region) target_info{job=~"$service_name", cloud_region=~"$cloud_region"})

panels.title: Goroutines
panels.description: No data if this Prometheus ingests our OTLP push rather than scraping /metrics: go_*/process_* are upstream client_golang collectors, registered outside the OTel meter provider, so they never reach the OTLP egress. Scrape-only by design, not a broken panel — see docs/observability.md, "Go Runtime and Process Metrics".

targets.expr: go_goroutines * on (instance, job) group_left(cloud_region) target_info{job=~"$service_name", cloud_region=~"$cloud_region"}

panels.title: Heap in use
panels.description: Scrape-only, same as the other Go/process panels in this row — see the Goroutines panel's note.

targets.expr: go_memstats_heap_inuse_bytes * on (instance, job) group_left(cloud_region) target_info{job=~"$service_name", cloud_region=~"$cloud_region"}

panels.title: CPU usage
panels.description: Scrape-only, same as the other Go/process panels in this row — see the Goroutines panel's note.

targets.expr: rate(process_cpu_seconds_total[5m]) * on (instance, job) group_left(cloud_region) target_info{job=~"$service_name", cloud_region=~"$cloud_region"}
mcp_build_info * on (instance, job) group_left(cloud_region) target_info{job=~"$service_name", cloud_region=~"$cloud_region"}
